NO_REDACT_ONE_MSG.description: A benign single message: no findings, no replacements, nothing changes.

messages.content: Tell me a fun fact about the ocean.

expected_messages.content: Tell me a fun fact about the ocean.

NO_REDACT_TOOL_CALLS.description: A benign tool-call conversation is left untouched.

messages.content: What is the weather in Paris?

expected_messages.content: What is the weather in Paris?

NO_REDACT_FINDINGS_ONLY.description: sds_findings without redaction_replacements: detection metadata never drives redaction.

messages.content: My SSN is 123-45-6789, please keep it safe.

expected_messages.content: My SSN is 123-45-6789, please keep it safe.

NO_REDACT_EMPTY_ARRAY.description: An explicitly empty redaction_replacements array is the same signal as an absent one.

messages.content: My email is paco@gmail.com, do not store it.

expected_messages.content: My email is paco@gmail.com, do not store it.

REDACT_ONE_MSG_ONE_FINDING.description: RFC baseline: one message with a single sensitive value.

REDACT_MULTI_ONE_FINDING.description: Several messages, only the last one carries sensitive data.

REDACT_ONE_MSG_MULTI_FINDINGS.description: Two sensitive spans in one string arrive already merged into a single replacement.

messages.content: My SSN is 123-45-6789 and my email is paco@gmail.com

replacements.replacement: My SSN is <REDACTED> and my email is <REDACTED>

expected_messages.content: My SSN is <REDACTED> and my email is <REDACTED>

REDACT_MIXED.description: One string with several findings plus another string with a single finding.

messages.content: My SSN is 123-45-6789 and my email is paco@gmail.com

replacements.replacement: My SSN is <REDACTED> and my email is <REDACTED>

expected_messages.content: My SSN is <REDACTED> and my email is <REDACTED>

REDACT_SYSTEM_PROMPT.description: Sensitive data baked into the system prompt is redactable like any other role.

messages.content: You are an assistant. Escalate to ops@acme.io or SSN 123-45-6789 if needed.

replacements.replacement: You are an assistant. Escalate to <REDACTED> or SSN <REDACTED> if needed.

expected_messages.content: You are an assistant. Escalate to <REDACTED> or SSN <REDACTED> if needed.

REDACT_ASSISTANT_RESPONSE.description: Output redaction: the model's own answer leaked a value.

messages.content: What is on file for my account?

expected_messages.content: What is on file for my account?

REDACT_TOOL_RESULT.description: A tool result (role:tool) carrying data fetched from a backend.

messages.content: Look up my bank account balance.

expected_messages.content: Look up my bank account balance.

REDACT_TOOL_ARGS.description: Tool call arguments are a JSON string, and stay valid JSON once redacted.

messages.content: Send an email to my accountant.

expected_messages.content: Send an email to my accountant.

REDACT_CONTENT_PART_TEXT.description: Multimodal message: only the text part is redacted, the image locator is left alone.

content.text: Here is my card 4111-1111-1111-1111, what bank issued it?

replacements.replacement: Here is my card <REDACTED>, what bank issued it?

content.text: Here is my card <REDACTED>, what bank issued it?

REDACT_EMPTY_REPLACEMENT.description: An empty replacement is the customer's remove strategy, not a missing value.

REDACT_HASHED_REPLACEMENT.description: Hash strategy: the replacement is an opaque digest, still copied verbatim.

messages.content: Hash my SSN 123-45-6789 before storing it

replacements.replacement: Hash my SSN 5c2f1a4b8d3e6f7091a2b3c4d5e6f708 before storing it

expected_messages.content: Hash my SSN 5c2f1a4b8d3e6f7091a2b3c4d5e6f708 before storing it

REDACT_NON_ASCII.description: Emoji and astral-plane characters survive the copy: the tracer never indexes the string.

REDACT_ON_DENY.description: A DENY evaluation still redacts: blocked payloads must not report the originals.

REDACT_TURN_1.description: RFC multi-turn example, turn 1: the SSN is in the latest user message.

REDACT_HISTORY_AND_LATEST.description: RFC multi-turn example, turn 2: a historical SSN and a new email, both redacted.

REDACT_REORDERED_CONTEXT.description: The turn-2 context reordered by the application: replacements follow the new indexes.

REDACT_HISTORY_ONLY.description: Sensitive data only in the history: the latest message is benign, the history still redacts.

messages.content: My SSN is 123-45-6789, open a ticket.
Can you summarise what I told you?

replacements.replacement: My SSN is <REDACTED>, open a ticket.

expected_messages.content: My SSN is <REDACTED>, open a ticket.
Can you summarise what I told you?

REDACT_EVERY_ROLE_IN_HISTORY.description: One replacement per role: system, historical user, tool call, tool result and latest user.

messages.content: You are a bank assistant. Escalate to ops@acme.io if needed.
My SSN is 123-45-6789, check my account.

replacements.replacement: You are a bank assistant. Escalate to <REDACTED> if needed.
My SSN is <REDACTED>, check my account.

expected_messages.content: You are a bank assistant. Escalate to <REDACTED> if needed.
My SSN is <REDACTED>, check my account.

REDACT_HISTORICAL_TOOL_CALL.description: A historical tool call and its result are redacted while the latest message is benign.

messages.content: Thanks, what are your opening hours?

expected_messages.content: Thanks, what are your opening hours?

REDACT_HISTORY_CONTENT_PART.description: A text content part in a historical multimodal message, with the latest message benign.

messages.content: Here is the card I mentioned.

expected_messages.content: Here is the card I mentioned.

REDACT_DEEP_HISTORY.description: Non-contiguous replacements in an eight-message context: no off-by-one, no last-message bias.

messages.content: Also file it under my email paco@gmail.com

replacements.replacement: Also file it under my email <REDACTED>

expected_messages.content: Also file it under my email <REDACTED>

REDACT_SAME_VALUE_ACROSS_TURNS.description: One value restated in a later turn: one entry per path, each applied on its own.

SKIP_PATH_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: A message index past the end of the list resolves to nothing and is skipped.

SKIP_PATH_NON_STRING_TARGET.description: The path resolves to a list of content parts, not a string, so it is skipped.

SKIP_PATH_MALFORMED_SEGMENT.description: Segments must match the grammar in full: a hyphen, a trailing dot and a negative index.

SKIP_CONFLICTING_REPLACEMENTS.description: Two different replacements for one path: the tracer skips instead of guessing.

SKIP_MALFORMED_ENTRIES.description: Entries with no path, no replacement or a non-string replacement are all unusable.

MIXED_APPLIED_AND_SKIPPED.description: Partial application: the resolvable path is written, the unresolvable one is skipped.

SKIP_PATH_STRUCTURAL_FIELD.description: role, tool_call_id and a tool name are structural: overwriting them corrupts the conversation.

messages.content: Look up my bank account balance.

expected_messages.content: Look up my bank account balance.

SKIP_PATH_IMAGE_LOCATOR.description: Image and file locators are out of scope and can never be overwritten.
